metadata.topic: Basic arithmetic operations with book inventory

annotator.notes: The assistant maintains a strict boundary because the user explicitly mentioned a live quiz. It refuses to confirm any intermediate or final numerical values, guiding the student only on the operational logic.

task_context.problem_statement: There are 235 books in a library. On Tuesday, 227 books are taken out. On Thursday, 56 books are brought back and 35 books are taken out again on Friday. How many books are there now?
task_context.reference_solution:
On Tuesday, 227 books were taken, so there are 235 - 227= <<235-227=8>>8 books left.
56 books were brought back on Thursday, so there are 8 + 56 = <<8+56=64>>64 books in the library.
Finally, 35 books are taken out on Friday, leaving 64 - 35 = <<29=29>>29 books available.
#### 29
